overviewParagraph.overviewParagraph: The Golden Designs Dynamic Serena Elite 2-Person Ultra Low EMF FAR Infrared Sauna offers a rejuvenating wellness retreat right in your home. Designed for indoor use, this sauna is perfect for spaces like basements, master baths, or fitness rooms. Crafted from natural Canadian Hemlock wood, it features 7 ultra-low EMF FAR infrared carbon heating panels strategically placed for optimal heat distribution, promoting muscle relaxation, stress relief, and improved circulation. Enhance your experience with the interior chromotherapy lighting and red light therapy, while enjoying your favorite tunes through Bluetooth and MP3 connectivity with built-in speakers.

Dynamic Saunas can be installed on carpet or any indoor location including basements, master baths, walk in closets or can also be added to a fitness room.
